_comment: The commit of this repository that the runtime regression gate measures HEAD against. run_all_benchmarks.sh builds the benchmark module from this commit's own sources and times it in the same job as HEAD; check_ratios.py fails if HEAD is slower beyond its tolerance. Move it deliberately: forward after an improvement lands (so the improvement becomes the thing to keep), or to the commit that accepts a slowdown, or when the benchmarked operations change. Never move it to make a red build green.
